name: Narinthorn 'Lynn' Srisuwan
bio:
Narinthorn, known as Lynn within Akkodis ASP Team, discovered her passion for motorsport during her engineering studies at Chulalongkorn University. Fascinated by aerodynamics, she specialized in fluid dynamics and secured an internship at a small wind tunnel facility. After graduating, she worked her way up, gaining experience in data analysis and model preparation. Her meticulous approach and keen eye for detail impressed her superiors, leading to her recruitment by Akkodis ASP. 

Lynn approaches her role with a blend of technical precision and collaborative spirit. She's always eager to explore new methodologies and adapt to the ever-evolving demands of motorsport aerodynamics. What sets her apart is her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, helping the team optimize vehicle performance. Her ambition is to one day lead a team of aerodynamicists and contribute to a world championship-winning car.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, usually tied back in a neat ponytail to keep it out of her face during experiments.
physical.description: Lynn is of medium height with a slender build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic equations and observations.
Prefers to listen to classical music while analyzing wind tunnel data.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
